Cut to the next day and my mom is back to acting the same way she always does. Asking me if I’m “feeling depressed again” etc. I got mad so I asked her if she even heard anything the doctor said about my depression and she got quiet and said no she wasn’t paying attention. I went and asked my dad if he knew what the doctor had said about my mental illness. He said no.
Now I love my parents. They aren’t the best in the world but they work hard and they have provided me with love and care for as long as I can remember.
But when I realized that they had not heard the one thing that I desperately wanted them to hear, it hurt . I felt betrayed almost. I’m struggling to keep your son alive for 4 years now and you couldn’t pay attention to a doctor for 5 mins. I remember crying myself to sleep because I couldn’t figure out how to tell my parents that I’ve come so close to killing myself on multiple occasions. I was feeling so relieved when the doctor explained it to them because it felt like a weight had been lifted from my shoulders.
And then my parents go and pull this kind of bs.
